preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 15, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Edges[i][0] <= N and 1 <= Edges[i][1] <= N for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: result == (1 if is_hamiltonian_path_present(N, M, Edges) else 0)
postconditions.description: The function returns true if there is a Hamiltonian path in the graph, otherwise returns false.
